_comment: Example .claude/settings.json wiring for Redi. `redi join` writes this for you; this file shows what it produces. Commands are PATH-resolved (`redi hook <event>`) so a committed project-level copy works on every machine and degrades to a no-op where redi isn't installed. Matchers are CASE-SENSITIVE: `Edit|Write` matches the Edit and Write tools. The token is NOT here — it lives in ~/.config/redi/credentials; only the non-secret COORD_URL goes in env (or in a committed .redi.toml).
